description: The linear ring of latex/notes/fct_experiment_plan.tex at sigma^2 = 0, sized for the large-N regime of fct.linear_theory: N = 512 hidden units, hidden kernel length_scale 2 sites (box = N), P = 256 patterns; linear_teacher with m = n = 4 features, K = 3 latents uniform on [0, 1] and an orthonormal teacher; L = 1, phi id, g 1; k0 = k1 = 1 (input and output kernels of length_scale 0 and amplitude 1, weight_lambda 1); r = rate_lambda = 0; beta 10 (target condensation, tau = 0.77, 0.21, 0.15); SGLD, float64; every population on the deterministic grid. B = 32 members, one sample per member (its final state); the records (every 10^4 epochs) feed only a drift check. predicted_spectra is the N -> infinity mean-field limit: it leaves out the readout's (n/2) log det term, an O(n/N) correction, so N/n is set by the falsifiers. Exact posterior (a Gibbs sampler, 512 chains) against the prediction, modes 1/2/3: R(1)/R(0) 0.9343/0.8916/0.8890 against 0.9350/0.8924/0.8896, R(2)/R(0) 0.7736/0.6352/0.6268 against 0.7757/0.6378/0.6289, band share (|q| <= 24) 0.664/0.483/0.474 against 0.668/0.486/0.476, Gaussian width at 2 sites 2.79/2.10/2.07 against 2.81/2.11/2.08, mode-1/mode-2 band power ratio 25.7 against 25.6. In SEs at B_max = 128 (the fourfold follow-up extension of B = 32) every primary statistic is within 0.1 to 0.8 SE, so the regime is accurate up to B_max (at N = 256 the errors would reach 1.1 SE there; at N = 16 the q = 0 power is half the predicted). The data term moves the same statistics from the prior by 33/5/3.5 SE at B = 32 (R(1)/R(0), modes 1/2/3), 31/4.7/3.3 (R(2)/R(0)), 21/3.1/2.2 (band share) and 12 (ratio), twice that at B_max. Falsified if a primary statistic of the member-averaged final-state spectrum lies further than 3 bootstrap SEs at the run's B from the prediction at this N (and the failure persists at 4B). The axes cross spatial.parametrisation [penalty, whitened] with train.lr [9e-5, 0.96], and the diagonal is the experiment: settings 0 and 3 (`exp run ROOT --index 0`, `--index 3`, or `bash jobs/fct_exp.sh ROOT --submit --index 0`); setting 1 (penalty at 0.96) is refused at run start; setting 2 (whitened at 9e-5) runs and is the lr check of the whitened result. Each lr is 0.9 of what its own run-start check accepts. Penalty (min_rel_eig 1e-6): lr weight_lambda stiffness / (2 beta) = 0.90, stiffness 1 / (min_rel_eig lambda_0) (refused at 1), which inflates the variance of the floored modes (|q| >= 215, prior variance 1e-6 lambda_0 each) by 1/(1 - 0.90) = 10x, a negligible part of the power. Whitened: lr lambda_max(loss Hessian) = 0.885 at the prior initial state (lambda_max 0.922; refused at 1), which inflates the stiffest mode, a data-carrying one, by 1/(1 - 0.44) = 1.8x and every prior-dominated mode by 1/(1 - lr / (2 beta)) = 1.05x; setting 2 measures what this does to the statistics. Run length: the whitened net relaxes within about 10^3 epochs; the penalty's slowest data-carrying direction has curvature about 1 / (beta lambda_0) = 0.02 and relaxes in about 1 / (lr x 0.02) = 6 x 10^5 epochs (an estimate, to be confirmed by the drift check), so n_epochs is 2 x 10^6. Both start from the prior (init prior, which whitened requires). Measured cost per epoch for all 32 members: about 8 ms (penalty) and 10 ms (whitened) on an RTX 4500 Ada GPU in float64, 39 and 29 ms on 8 CPU threads, so 2 x 10^6 epochs take about 4.5 and 5.5 GPU hours (22 and 16 CPU hours). Another beta or weight_lambda needs its own lr pair by the same rule (--set beta=, --axis 'train.lr=[...]') and a new regime check.
